name: pilot_claude
notes: Thinking off: MAX_THINKING_TOKENS unset, alwaysThinkingEnabled=false, effort low where supported. Haiku 5.5 excluded because it thinks regardless of flags. No temperature, max_tokens, or logprobs control through the CLI, so C1L is dropped. All models are one family: matched predictors are nearest-tier siblings, which tests self vs same-family (the spec's shared-data control), not cross-family. Judge is in-family; acceptable for H1 because the target is fixed, so both predictors are scored against the same labels.
